messages:
rachel: not a typical Friday thread but i made "AstroPromptGPT" last night and it's now giving zodiac horoscopes in prompt advice format. results are chaotic :star2:
arjun: oh no please share a sample :eyes:
taylor: this is peak redwood culture, we need to see it. also voting if we adopt it as the company horoscope for sprint planning :laughing:
rachel: ok sample outputs below:
````
Aries: system_prompt="You are FierceAssistant. Suggest one bold refactor and one snack." -> "Refactor the helpers module; bring spicy hummus."
Taurus: system_prompt="You are GroundedAdvisor. Recommend stability and small comforts." -> "Lock deps to patch versions; buy oat milk."
Gemini: system_prompt="You are TwoTone. Offer two contradictory ideas and call it a test." -> "Split the feature branch; also pair program at lunch."
````
(yes it's silly)
ben: this is brilliant. can it do release-day horoscopes? "Scorpio: avoid merge storms, prefer canary deployments." :rocket:
arjun: we should add a small safety rule: no career advice or salary fortune telling. HR will come for us. :grimacing:
taylor: poll: do we make AstroPromptGPT the official Friday ritual? link: https://tinyurl.com/astro-poll-redwood :ballot_box:
ops-bot: note logged: 'astro_prompt_gpt_proposal' created by rachel. review scheduled in 48h. :calendar:
rachel: extras: i made a tiny sticker that says "Ask your horoscope, not your manager" and a short system prompt we can stick in the kitchen:
````
You are AstroPromptGPT. Generate playful, non-actionable prompt-ified horoscopes. Avoid real-world medical, legal, or career promises. Keep it under 20 words.
````
arjun: love the constraints. also gif suggestion: cosmic laptop cat as mascot. taylor will design? :cat2:
taylor: on it. will do three colors and one glitter version for special sprints.
ben: if this gets adopted, Friday standup gets a new segment: "Horoscope & Hotfix." low overhead, high vibes. :sparkles:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: astro_proposal_review @ next-all-hands. Auto-created per workflow.
